title: Per-Insured Aggregate Limit on Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance Coverage
content:
## Aggregation of CareAssure coverage on one insured

**Rule.** Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance coverage under Ashgrove CareAssure policies is aggregated per insured, the insured being identified by insured name and date of birth. A new policy is issued only if the specified amount already in force on that insured plus the new specified amount does not exceed the aggregate specified amount limit of $1000000. When an insured is covered by more than one CareAssure policy, the monthly benefits paid for the same month across all of them may not exceed the qualified expenses incurred in that month; each policy pays up to its own monthly maximum, the earlier-issued policy first.

**The specified amount already on the insured** is, at the evaluation date, the total of the specified amounts of every CareAssure policy on the same insured (same insured name and same date of birth) whose status is not Declined, Lapsed, Surrendered, Claim Paid, Claim Denied or Cancelled under the free look. A policy that is Applied, In Force, in its Grace Period, Paid Up, on the Shortened Benefit period, Claim Active, Benefits Exhausted or Death Claim Pending is therefore counted.

### Issue test — boundary cases (hypothetical amounts)

| Specified amount already on the insured | New specified amount requested | Total | Issued under this rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| $600000 | $400000 | $1000000 | Yes — the total does not exceed $1000000 |
| $600000 | $450000 | $1050000 | No — the total exceeds $1000000 |
| $300000 in force, plus a lapsed $500000 policy | $700000 | $1000000 | Yes — the lapsed policy is not counted |

The limit binds the insured, not the owner: two policies owned by different owners on the same insured name and date of birth are added together.

### Monthly benefits across several policies — worked case (hypothetical figures)

An insured is covered by Policy A, issued first, with a monthly maximum of $4000.00, and Policy B, issued later, with a monthly maximum of $3000.00.

| Qualified expenses incurred in the month | Policy A pays (earlier-issued, first) | Policy B pays | Total for the month |
|---|---|---|---|
| $5500.00 | $4000.00 | $1500.00 | $5500.00 |
| $8000.00 | $4000.00 | $3000.00 | $7000.00 |
| $3200.00 | $3200.00 | $0.00 | $3200.00 |

In each row the total paid for the month does not exceed the qualified expenses incurred in that month, and no policy pays beyond its own monthly maximum.
